answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work. Reaching the forge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A shale of per-task receipts records who did what, and the prism of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
